cars.generation: Original PD-based i30 N production-road performance family
cars.variant: 275-PS Performance Package manual hatchback — 2017 European LHD launch brochure
cars.specification_market: Original pre-facelift i30 N five-door hatchback, European left-hand-drive 2017 launch-brochure specification, selected 275-PS Performance Package and six-speed manual. The factory PDF filename says 2018 but its footer is copyright 2017, EU. LHD 1027 ENG; use 2017 launch reference, not an inferred registration year. Count this original PD-based N road family once, including the later Fastback and facelift. Not an ordinary i30/Elantra GT, N Line appearance trim, Veloster N, TCR racer, Project C or later 280-PS/DCT configuration. Factory performance figures are claims, not independent measurements. No curb mass, torque peak, emissions, price or production total is assigned.
cars.summary: The i30 N established Hyundai’s N performance-car identity. Its first-hand contemporary road review supports the significance of the adjustable chassis, traction and engaging handling, while acknowledging turbo lag, torque steer, firm ride and noise. The original manual Performance hatchback represents the road family once across outputs, bodies, years and facelift changes.

sources.title: The All-New i30 N — European LHD launch brochure, EU. LHD 1027 ENG
sources.notes: 19-page PDF, 8,484,075 bytes; PDF indexes 5 (printed 10–11), 6 (12–13), 7 (14–15), 16 (32–33) and 18 (back cover) individually visually read. Technical table distinguishes 250-PS base from selected 275-PS Performance; use table PS rather than loose HP marketing heading. Height/dimensions expressly based on Performance 19-inch wheels. Torque 353 Nm and temporary overboost 378 Nm kept distinct, no peak speed invented. Brochure warns that specifications are preliminary and European equipment varies. Curb-mass range and luggage volume without stiffness bar are not assigned.

sources.title: 2018 Hyundai i30 N — Mike Duff, 6 February 2018
sources.notes: Relevant full review and specification panel read. Admission and limitations only; no review estimates imported as measured times, weight or economy. Review tested Performance version on British roads; it does not establish all European optional equipment.

sources.title: The Hyundai i30 N — launch press information, July 2017 cover / September filename
sources.notes: Relevant PDF web text, cover/contents and introductory pages 3–5 read. Establishes first high-performance model under N and intended European launch by end 2017. This is not a claim of reviewing the complete 17-page PDF or its technical tables. Road N is not the development endurance-race car; no competition specification or race result imported.
